chapter: Tuba players and New Orleans bands
title: Early tuba players and New Orleans tuba men today
summary: Hearing a tuba solo, Barbarin names Lawson Buford, Bill Moore and Boyd Cobb as great tuba men and discusses current New Orleans tuba players.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I wonder what the first tuba solo on record was.
Well, that's the first time I heard a tuba, when I heard this one, man. That's Johnny Dots, eh? That's great, man. man. That's great,
That's great. . . Good tuba, man. Good tuba, man. That boy, Kyle. I'd like to hear Buford on tuba and also Bill Moore, I mean if you want to play the record for me. Sure.
Oh yeah, he's on that film?
I always think of him as Kelly Role-Martin, you know?

Yeah, Lawson Buford. All three of those guys are great tuba men. Who are they? Lawson Buford and Bill Moore, William Moore, and Boyd Cobbs. I mean all three of them are very good. Very good tuba players. That's what I was trying to tell you a few days back that by the tuba players, those are tuba players, that's what I call tuba players. I don't like to throw in rocks at nobody, you know what I mean? But let's face it, you know what I mean? They don't have it today.
They have a couple of tuba players around here. I mean like the guy I play with John Kazma, he's pretty good. What's his name again? Tillman, Wilbert Tillman.

Wilbert Tillman, he's pretty good. And the guy I play with, the Gibson band that I heard, I mean playing a few of them, I think I was standing at St. Claude between Oisline and Governor Nicholas. And Willie Humphrey told me that tuba player he was a barber. And I can't recall his name. He's a barber, he's a good tuba player. It's not Louis Caput though.

You know Louis Caput. No, no, no. I can't tell you who that is. I'll have to ask him around. Well you try. Ask Dave Bailey what you're saying. Yeah. Or this boy out there, you'll holler out today, what was his name again?
McNeil, yeah. Ask him. They played a funeral for Blanet, Blanet's Undertaker.
